forms.title: Liberia Visa on Arrival pre-application (Liberia Immigration Service)
forms.stoppedAt: Step 1, Create an account (name, surname and email); the application form is behind the login. The portal's public step list and FAQ were read.

steps.name: Prepare your documents
notices: Passport (obligatory): Must be valid for at least six months.
Passport scan (obligatory): A maximum size of 2 MB, in PDF, BMP, JPG, JPEG or PNG formats.
Portrait photo (obligatory): Neutral background, in color, with a maximum size of 2 MB, in BMP, JPG, JPEG or PNG formats.
Flight ticket scan (optional): A maximum size of 2 MB, in PDF, BMP, JPG, JPEG or PNG formats.

steps.name: Pay the Visa on Arrival fee
notices: The Visa on Arrival fee (USD 102.5) is non-refundable.

steps.name: Receive your Visa on Arrival confirmation
notices: Once approved, Liberia Visa on Arrival application is valid for entry into the country within 3 months. If you do not enter Liberia within this period, you will need to start the application process again.

steps.name: Collect your Visa sticker at the airport in Liberia
notices: An immigration officer will assist you with biometric data collection (fingerprints and face recognition). Once completed, you will receive a visa sticker in your passport.
If there is a Liberian embassy in your country, you are required to apply for your visa directly at the embassy and not through this portal.
Visa on Arrival is currently available only upon arrival at the Roberts International Airport (ROB) in Monrovia, Liberia.
The validity of the Visa on Arrival is determined by the officer at the airport based on the estimated time of the visit to the country (30 or 90 days).
